Original note: Probe: the dialog is reached from the fullpage library's `⭳ Import URL` button, which needs the manager and a composer behind it; the modal itself takes three props and nothing else.

NOT joined: 1205:4804 the card — MODAL_FRAME_BASE_CLASS is shared by every dialog in the editor and ModalTitle/ModalBody own the insets (the call export-html-modal recorded for 1172:4825). 1205:4808 the field — boards.json holds chrome-ui TextInput at authority=open:input-fill, and THIS BOARD IS ONE OF THE TWO that disagree (it fills #F9FAFB where 1172:4867 fills #F3F4F6), so it is the last board that gets to settle it. 1205:4813 / 1205:4815, the button labels at 11px: those sit inside flowbite's own Button span, a shared primitive measured across the modal family.

1205:4812 / 1205:4814, the two buttons, are NOT joined either — and the reason is board-vs-board, not code-vs-board. They are the bare chrome-ui Button (no call-site override), which ships border --bk-gray-300, 6px of vertical padding and radius 8. This board asks for --color/border, 8 and 6; board 1175:4827, one frame away in the same Media modal family, asks for 7 and 6. Two boards cannot settle a primitive that every dialog in the editor draws from, so it keeps the primitive's values. Where a call site DOES own its buttons — ConfirmDeleteModal, which sets its own fill and border — the board's 12/7/6 was conformed.
